_help: Companies whose job boards the loop polls every run. REPLACE the keywords and boards below with yours; the shipped values are only an example.

Find a company's vendor and slug with: python3 scripts/probe_board.py <slug> (run from the skill folder). The slug is the company's name as it appears in its apply links (jobs.lever.co/<slug>, boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, <slug>.recruitee.com, apply.workable.com/<slug>).

Matching: a posting is shown when its title contains any title_keyword as a whole word, none of title_exclude, and its location contains any location_keyword as a whole word. A posting the vendor marks remote with an empty location passes the location filter if 'remote' is in location_keywords. To get 'remote EU only', list the countries or regions you accept; 'remote' alone also lets in remote roles in other countries.
careers_pages are NOT polled by the script; the loop opens them in a browser, oldest last_checked first. Set carryover to true on a page you want opened every run.
vendor is one of: greenhouse, lever, lever-eu, ashby, recruitee, workable.

boards.note: fully remote; many roles are region-locked

careers_pages.note: no public feed; open in a browser
